question_cn: 2026世界杯小组赛K组：乌兹别克斯坦 vs 哥伦比亚（2026-06-17）90分钟赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group K: Uzbekistan vs Colombia (2026-06-17) — 90-minute result?
one_liner_cn: 哥伦比亚实力、状态与阵容完整度全面占优，约65%概率取胜；乌兹别克斯坦首秀且队长舒穆罗多夫伤情存疑，防守拖平是其最现实出路。
one_liner_en: Colombia hold a comprehensive edge in strength, form and availability (~65% to win); debutants Uzbekistan, with captain Shomurodov an injury doubt, are most likely chasing a defensive draw.

key_reasons.cn: Elo差距268分（哥伦比亚1982 vs 乌兹别克斯坦1714），Davidson模型给出哥伦比亚约65%基准胜率
key_reasons.en: 268-point Elo gap (Colombia 1982 vs Uzbekistan 1714); the Davidson model gives Colombia ~65% baseline win probability

key_reasons.cn: 乌兹别克斯坦队长、国家队史射手王Shomurodov在6月8日友谊赛对荷兰第24分钟伤退，首战出场存疑
key_reasons.en: Uzbekistan captain and all-time top scorer Shomurodov went off injured in the 24th minute vs the Netherlands on Jun 8; doubtful for the opener

key_reasons.cn: 哥伦比亚26人名单无伤病报告，J罗与迪亚斯领衔，6月8日2-0完胜约旦，状态上佳
key_reasons.en: Colombia's 26-man squad has no reported injuries; James and Diaz lead the side after a 2-0 win over Jordan on Jun 8

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gave 13.9/21.1/65.0; bounded evidence adjustment of ~2.8pp total (cap 8pp) for Shomurodov injury doubt, Colombia availability/form, and Uzbekistan's defensive 5-4-1 raising draw likelihood; renormalized to 12.5/22.0/65.5. No betting or prediction-market inputs used.
